description: This file contains custom decorators and utility classes/functions for use with Python unittests, including mechanisms for test dependencies, logging, tagging, and timeout handling.

classes.name: getResults
classes.description: Utility class to extract test results (failures, errors, skipped) from the current unittest context.

classes.name: skipIfFailure
classes.description: Decorator to skip a test if a specified test case has failed or errored.

classes.name: skipIfSkipped
classes.description: Decorator to skip a test if a specified test case has been skipped.

classes.name: skipUnlessPassed
classes.description: Decorator to skip a test unless a specified test case has passed.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Decorator to attach a test case identifier to a test function.

classes.name: NoParsingFilter
classes.description: Logging filter that allows only log records with levelno 100 (RESULTS).

classes.name: LogResults
classes.description: Decorator that wraps unittest.TestCase.run to log test results into a file with custom formatting.

classes.name: TimeOut
classes.description: Custom exception class for timeout events.

classes.name: timeout
classes.description: Decorator to enforce a timeout on a function using signal alarms.

classes.name: tag
classes.description: Decorator to add custom attribute tags to classes or functions for filtering.

classes.name: gettag
classes.description: Function to retrieve a specific tag attribute from an object or test method.

classes.name: getAllTags
classes.description: Function to retrieve all tags from an object or test method.

classes.name: timeout_handler
classes.description: Decorator similar to 'timeout' that also calls self.target.restart() on timeout.
